title: the train will always pass you by
author: Naarel

archive.primary: the train will always pass you by.html

description:
I live near the train tracks. Every day, I can see trains passing right by the forest in the distance.

There’s such pain in watching the trains go by, knowing that they won’t stop for you.

A short story about transport exclusion and rural pain, written entirely on a train.
